title: Theo and the Letters
author: Coral Coldharbour
blurb: Coral Whitlock, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
